svg.aria-label: Two curves over time. Your own output rises quickly and then flattens, capped by your hours. Leverage starts slower and keeps rising, because it is what other people can do without you, and it does not stop when you do.
svg.text: TWO WAYS TO BE USEFUL, MEASURED OVER A YEAR

g.text: The crossing point is late, invisible while it is happening, and the reason this work needs
a name: nobody rewards a curve they cannot see yet, so you have to be able to point at it.
